questions.stem: Which statement is true about the number $-7$?

options.text: It is an integer but not a natural number

questions.explanation: $-7$ is an integer because it is a whole unit on the number line. However, natural numbers are positive counting numbers ($1, 2, 3, ...$), so $-7$ is not a natural number. It is also rational since $-7 = \frac{-7}{1}$.
